instruction: No third policy is chosen, trained or benchmarked. No third-policy campaign runs until Alba provides the exact selected checkpoint and frozen configuration.
evidence_basis: Read-only on 2026-11-01: Hugging Face model API, config.json and README at the listed revision; pinned LeRobot source b6ec0060779550c0a157ae34feb89e0cf86012a8. Nothing was downloaded in full, loaded or run. No value here is a measured capability. A gate reads met_by_documentation only when the file or source named in its note says so; unknown means it was not established and does not count as met.
strict_reading: Alba asked for candidates that satisfy ALL gates. No candidate is fully established, because action-unit documentation and record completeness can only be confirmed by reading the code path and running it. The list therefore holds candidates with no gate shown to fail, ranked by evidence.

considered_and_set_aside.reason: Passes the same read-only checks, but it is the pi0 family, close to Model B, and runs on the LeRobot PyTorch route Alba excluded for pi0.5. It adds little family diversity. Alba may overrule this.
10.1 GiB and the config has num_flow_timesteps 8 with num_inference_steps null, so which field controls solver steps needs reading first. Not excluded on evidence; ranked out on effort.
Not iterative denoising: the controllable solver-step gate fails by construction.
